fields.value: Replication Data for: Combining acoustic tracking and LiDAR to study bat flight behaviour in three-dimensional space

dsDescriptionValue.value: Replication data for the manuscript 'Combining acoustic tracking and LiDAR to study bat flight behaviour in three-dimensional space'. Data from acoustic localisation of bats and LiDAR vegetation scans at sites that are part of the 'Light on Nature' project.

files.description: 3D positions of pipistrelles calculated by cross correlation from the microphone array's recordings before and after rotation and translation to be aligned with the corresponding LiDAR scan (X_raw, Y_raw, Z_raw coordinates vs X_rotated, Y_rotated, Z_rotated coordinates. Data used in the first case study of the manuscript.

files.description:
Raw 3D positions of bats calculated by cross correlation from the microphone array's recordings - multiple individuals recorded at the same time. 

time = time of call detection relative to file start (s) ; x/y/z_from_array_centre/z_from_ground = coordinates of the reconstructed position (m) ; height_array = height of the array centre from the ground ; max_error_mm = maximum TOAD distance error (mm) ; tan_error = tangential error (mm) ; rad_error = radial error (mm) ; distance_xyz = distance from the calculated position to the center of the microphone array (m)
files.label: multiple_tracks.csv
